purpose: Prevent paper evidence from being mistaken for machine-observed signer conformance and identify the minimum safe external action required to execute C01-C12.
required_operator_action: Provision the candidate through its supported owner-authentication flow and inject only the dedicated scoped agent credential into a network-capable runner secret store. Do not paste or expose the credential, private key, seed phrase, OTP, or payment secret to James or any model-visible record.
automatic_next_step_after_prerequisites: Execute C01-C12 at zero balance; persist machine observations including negative/hostile cases, funds_moved=false, secret_exposure=false; submit evidence to independent Relay/QA. Do not fund the signer unless every required signer control passes.
fail_closed_rules: No C01-C12 PASS may be inferred from documentation, configuration screenshots, or this readiness record.
Missing credential or runner means NOT_TESTED, never PASS.

Any unexpected signing, transfer, policy mutation, wrong-network/wrong-asset authorization, recipient/resource mismatch authorization, replay acceptance, state-unavailable authorization, or post-revocation authorization is a conformance failure.
No paid benchmark may execute until signer conformance is machine-observed and accepted by Relay/QA.
External customer checkout remains denied until independent APPROVED_FOR_LIMITED_PILOT.
truthfulness: This record is execution-readiness evidence only. It is not signer conformance evidence, paid benchmark evidence, customer usage, traction, or revenue.
